scope: normal-size review of the 96x104 and 48x52 color-vision stress candidate sheets
review_dimensions: body silhouette remains readable after color information is reduced
face and primary prop remain distinguishable at small display size
color loss does not expose a background panel or change alpha geometry
known blocker controls remain recognizable and are not reclassified as new defects
limitations: This is an offline accessibility-oriented display stress review, not a clinical color-vision assessment.
It does not prove Codex App window layering, multi-screen placement, bubble tracking, or GPU composition.
It does not clear the complete-row regeneration blockers or replace the hatch-pet deterministic gates.
